integrity: Classical syndrome-measurement coding and classical code parameters are prior work and are not claimed as new. The new claim is the exact identification of weak-measurement attenuation exponents with codeword weights and the resulting minimum-distance optimization.
scientific_limitations: Exact spectrum and Hilbert--Schmidt contraction of one equal-strength nonselective weak-stabilizer measurement layer; not an exact open-system trace-distance theorem after interleaved dynamics. A differently phrased or unindexed source may already state the same weak-measurement/code-distance correspondence. Searches and inspected close sources did not locate one.
title: Classical-code distance is the exact weak-stabilizer contraction exponent
